voice_description: A large adult male orc warrior with a deep baritone voice, broad chest resonance, coarse gravelly timbre, firm articulation, and strong physical presence. Blunt, fearless, practical, impatient, and battle-hardened. Powerful and intimidating without needing to shout. The roughness should remain natural enough for warm, quiet, and forceful speech.
direction: The orc becomes strongly angry but controlled. Increase vocal force and gravelly emphasis without roaring or shouting. He sounds dangerous because he is restraining himself.

text: You were told to leave the village alone. I gave you that choice because I prefer solving problems without bloodshed. If you cross that bridge again, you will discover exactly how much patience I was showing you.
